svg.text: Norsk Data ND-500 in two cabinets, model 12
ND-560 and ND-500/CX Model 22 | two cabinets of 169 x 60 x 91 cm
Plug panel on the rear post:
Plug panel on the rear post:
Cutaway of the ND-500 cabinet; the ND-100 cabinet stands closed beside it. Heights from the nutclip hole numbers in ND Book 2 chapter 14. Book 2 never draws the ND-100 cabinet itself.
Which crate is upper is read from one isometric (drawing 20497). Sources: ND-B2C14.pdf, ND-B2C15.pdf.
Colour: dark brown, from the ND-560 brochure photograph; the exact paint is not documented.
